name: crundi
description: Self-hosted remote workbench for your projects — agent terminals, files, git, kanban, mindmap and scheduling, reachable from anywhere.

scripts.service:install: pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs && pm2 save && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/startup-install.ps1
scripts.service:uninstall: pm2 stop crundi && pm2 delete crundi && pm2 save && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/startup-uninstall.ps1
